audit.action: cite a better source for the same coding
audit.reasoning: Quote verified verbatim at the cited page/section in a held full text of the deciding source (the record's held list should point to litreview/sources/; grade field is blank and can be set now that the quote is confirmed in-hand). The deciding source is the fieldworker's own 2002 sketch and, per Glottolog and web search, the only phonological description of Tobati in existence; 'regularly... penultimate' matches the fixed-dominant (non-strict) penult coding '10 010 0010 00010'. Not 'well-sourced' only because the evidence is one sentence in an 18-page sketch with no detail on exceptions or secondary stress; nothing found suggests the coding is wrong. Wishlist items are low-priority long shots (Indonesian syntax report, Cowan's 1950s notes); no open copies located.
